'''2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 Joe Olson DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2008 Texas Match Play Championship]] (Day 2). The printout's Player Name box is blank; the file name printed in its footer is <code>joeds_day2.html</code>.

Attribution uncertain: the file name gives only the first name Joe, and [[Joe Olson]] was the only Joe among the four players of Day 2.<ref name="pc-sid85">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132641/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=85 Kevin Shannon wins the Texas MPC] (1 May 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 August 2008.</ref> The deck choices posted for Olson on Saturday 26 April were WYS and Hunt Down, not this deck.<ref name="sf-20608-296728">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=296728#p296728 Texas MPC 08 - Saturday Deck Choices], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (27 April 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182426/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20608.html Internet Archive]</ref> {{Mystery|question=Did Joe Olson play this deck at the 2008 Texas Match Play Championship|section=2008 Texas Match Play Championship Day 2 sheets|type=deck}}

The sheet lists 60 cards and, under the heading Defensive Shields, twelve more; they are given here as printed.
